readme:
# Das Telefonbuch Scraper

**What you get:** Lead generation data from Das Telefonbuch (Germany): business names, phone numbers, addresses, websites and categories, one row per listing.

**Input example:** `{"searchQuery": "Rechtsanwalt", "location": "Berlin", "searchType": "business", "maxResults": 10, "includeDetails": true}`

**Output example:** `{"name": "Restaurant und Bierhaus Xantener Eck", "address": "Xantener Str. 1, 10707 Berlin", "phone": "030 8 83 90 14", "email": "mail@das-xantener-eck.de", "website": "http://www.das-xantener-eck.de", "category": "Gaststätten und Restaurants Berlin", "rating": 1, "review_count": 1, "source_platform": "dastelefonbuch.de"}`

> **Integration stopped on Nov 11?** After a security incident, Apify rotated the API tokens of affected accounts. If yours was rotated and you call this Actor from n8n, Make, Zapier or your own code, paste your new token (Console → Settings → API & Integrations). Schedules inside Apify were not affected.

Scrape business and person listings from [Das Telefonbuch](https://www.dastelefonbuch.de), Germany's official phone directory covering millions of businesses and residents.

## How to scrape Das Telefonbuch

Enter a search word in `searchQuery` (for example a trade like "Steuerberater" or a surname) and a city or region in `location`, then start the run. Set `searchType` to `business` for company listings or `person` for private person entries. Each result is one dataset row with name, address, phone number, website, category and more. Switch on `includeDetails` to also get email, opening hours and reviews from each listing's detail page. You can download the dataset as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read it through the Apify API.

Main fields: `name`, `address`, `street`, `postal_code`, `city`, `phone`, `fax`, `mobile`, `email`, `website`, `category`, `opening_hours`, `rating`, `review_count`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `entry_id`, `source_url`, `scraped_at`. The full list is in the Output Fields table below.

Price: $2 per 1,000 rows from search results, or $5 per 1,000 rows that include detail page data, plus $0.001 per run start. The price is the same on every Apify plan.

Example row (trimmed, from a run with `includeDetails` on):

```json

  "name": "Restaurant und Bierhaus Xantener Eck",
  "address": "Xantener Str. 1, 10707 Berlin",
  "street": "Xantener Str. 1",
  "postal_code": "10707",
  "city": "Berlin",
  "phone": "030 8 83 90 14",
  "email": "mail@das-xantener-eck.de",
  "website": "http://www.das-xantener-eck.de",
  "category": "Gaststätten und Restaurants Berlin",
  "opening_hours": "Mo 12:00-24:00; Tu 12:00-24:00; We 12:00-24:00; Th 12:00-24:00; Fr 12:00-24:00; Sa 12:00-24:00; Su 12:00-24:00",
  "rating": 1,
  "review_count": 1,

  "scraped_at": "2026-11-03T06:34:03Z"
}
```

## Features

- **Keyword + location search** - Find businesses or residents by type and city
- **Business & person search** - Toggle via `searchType` (`business` or `person`)
- **Pagination** - Automatically crawls multiple result pages, follows the site's own `rel="next"` link for robustness
- **Pay-per-result pricing** - Only pay for what you scrape

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/telefonbuch-de-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `telefonbuch-de-scraper` to scrape company data from telefonbuch de. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output Fields

Every result includes these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `company_logo_url` | string | Real business logo from Das Telefonbuch's CDN (`ies.v4all.de`), never a generic placeholder |
| `name` | string | Unique business or person name (taken from `<h1 itemprop="name">`, never the site's generic "Das Telefonbuch" org block) |
| `description` | string | The business's own "Unternehmensprofil" text. Only present for listings that have a premium profile (roughly 5-10% of entries); otherwise null. Requires detail pages |
| `address` | string | Full formatted address |
| `street` | string | Street line incl. house number |
| `postal_code` | string | 5-digit German postal code |
| `city` | string | City |
| `country` | string | Always `DE` |
| `phone` | string | **Full** phone number (never truncated) |
| `fax` | string | **Full** fax number (never truncated) |
| `mobile` | string | Mobile number (015x/016x/017x) when the listing publishes one, which is rare (about 3%); otherwise null. Requires detail pages |
| `email` | string | Email address shown on the listing. Only on detail pages, so empty when detail pages are switched off |
| `website` | string | Official business website |
| `category` | string | Business category, with the redundant `Branche:` prefix stripped |
| `opening_hours` | string | Full weekly schedule when available (e.g. `Mo 08:00-18:00; Tu 08:00-18:00; ...`) |
| `rating` | number | Aggregate star rating (0–5) |
| `review_count` | number | Total number of reviews across all sources |
| `search_keywords` | string[] | Keywords from the "Unsere Suchbegriffe" section |
| `external_review_sources` | object[] | Per-source breakdown with `source`, `rating`, `count`, `url` (Google, Yelp, 11880, golocal, TripAdvisor, anwalt.de, kennstdueinen.de, speisekarte.de, jameda, …) |
| `recent_reviews` | object[] | Individual review entries with `source`, `rating`, `author`, `date`, `text`, `url` |
| `services` | string[] | Services listed under "Dienstleistungen" (detail pages) |
| `categories` | string[] | All industry headings (Branchen) of the listing |
| `district` | string | City district (Stadtteil), detail pages |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | number | Coordinates of the listing, detail pages |
| `is_premium` | boolean | `true` for paid Premium listings |
| `entry_id` | string | Das Telefonbuch entry id |
| `last_updated` | string | Date the publisher last updated the listing (`YYYY-MM-DD`), detail pages |
| `updated_at` | string | Same date as `last_updated`, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` (detail pages) |
| `updated_at_text` | string | Raw "Aktualisiert am ..." text as shown on the page (detail pages) |
| `contact_persons` | object[] | Persons / further entries under "Weitere Einträge und Filialen", each with `name`, `title`, `phone`, `email`, `address` (their own direct contact data as published; empty list when the page has none; detail pages) |
| `source_url` | string | Original detail page URL |
| `source_platform` | string | Always `dastelefonbuch.de` |
| `search_type` | string | `business` or `person` |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO-8601 UTC timestamp |

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Default |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `searchQuery` | string | Search keyword (e.g., "Steuerberater", "Müller") | Required |
| `location` | string | City or region (e.g., "Frankfurt", "Berlin") | Required |
| `searchType` | string | `business` or `person` | `business` |
| `maxResults` | number | Maximum results to return | 100 |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Fetch detail pages for full profiles | true |

## How to use

Business search (Branchensuche):

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "Steuerberater",
  "location": "Frankfurt",
  "searchType": "business",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

Person search (residential phone book), search results only:

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "Müller",
  "location": "Hamburg",
  "searchType": "person",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": false
}
```

## Pricing

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start | $0.001 |
| Search result (SERP only) | $0.002 / result |
| Detail result (with full profile) | $0.005 / result |

## FAQ

**Do I need an account on Das Telefonbuch or any extra setup?** No. The source pages are public.

**How many results can I get?** Set `maxResults` between 1 and 5000. The actor follows the site's result pagination until the limit or the last page is reached.

**What is the difference between search results and detail results?** With `includeDetails` off you get the data shown in the result list (billed as a search result). With it on, each listing's detail page is fetched for email, opening hours, reviews and the company profile (billed as a detail result).

**Can I search for private persons?** Yes, set `searchType` to `person`. See the data protection section below before using such data.

**How fresh is the data?** Every run reads the live site, so results reflect what Das Telefonbuch shows at that moment (see `scraped_at`).

**Can I export Das Telefonbuch entries to Excel or CSV?** Yes. Every run stores its rows in an Apify dataset, which you can download as CSV, Excel, JSON, XML or HTML.

**Does it include phone numbers and addresses?** Yes. Each row has `phone`, `address`, `street`, `postal_code` and `city` when the listing shows them. `email` comes from detail pages, so keep `includeDetails` on for it.

**Is there an API?** Yes. You can start the actor and fetch its dataset with the Apify API, using the same input fields as in the Input Parameters table.

## Data protection

This actor returns only data that is publicly visible on the source pages. Results can include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses and addresses of private persons, sole traders or contact persons. Where the source labels an entry type, it is included so you can filter the results yourself.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including the GDPR/DSGVO, national data-protection laws and unfair-competition rules (e.g. UWG) for marketing and outreach.
